arguments.literal: Authority is never minted from capability, a label or reachability.
Smaller changes may re-enter below Goals only if they explicitly assert that no upstream constitutional surface is changing. The absence of a declared change class is process drift.
P4b, P2

C denotes reproducible facts and declared rule application; J denotes residual semantic or materiality judgment; O denotes a ruling reserved to its actual owner. The annotations grant no authority and introduce no calculus kind, runtime, classifier interface or mandatory document.
P4b, P6, P1

Class -> re-enters at; flows through: goal_reprice (current bounded work-wave focus changes) -> Goals; Intent, Product, Requirements, Design, Code and Evidence where that focus changes deeper constitutional truth. intent_reprice (directional or scope change) -> Intent; Product, Requirements, Design, Code, Evidence. product_reprice (current product realisation changes while directional intent stays stable) -> Product; Requirements, Design, Code, Evidence. requirement_reprice (constitutional truth changes while project direction stays stable) -> Requirements; Design, Code, Evidence. design_reframe (realisation structure changes while active intent and requirement truth stay stable) -> Design; Code, Evidence. realization_refactor (local code, configuration or attribute change with no intended constitutional or structural change) -> the realised surface only; nothing upstream, and it must prove no upstream drift.

Changed material inputs or a declared revising observation invalidate the affected result before reliance, preserving the predecessor and any demonstrably independent surviving results; a changed basis invalidates likewise.
Return A Closed Result names inputs and observation; TICKET judgment continuity names basis.
A changed governing relation is accepted only at its owner; accepting it inside the acting frame is a violation, whatever the size of the delta.

The explicitly selected source, worksite or qualification capability produces C over the exact request and desired outcome, the known targets and effects, the operation grant and work lifetime, the product definition and governing basis, the baseline and the available candidate, the declared relations, the accepted design and trace bindings, the evidence and the applicable rules. Its output identifies the producer and procedure revision, the inputs, the result, the scope, the source routes, the reproduction relation, the unknowns and the invalidators. A missing candidate or missing evidence is an input state, not a claim that nothing changed.
P4b, P6

A new role, conversation or resumption reuses valid C after checking exact applicability. A changed request, candidate, basis, owner or root relation, projection, design trace or acceptance, rule, configuration or material evidence invalidates its affected claims before reliance; the wider frontier is recomputed where independence is unproved.
P4b

The computed result exposes, in order: (1) Authority traversal: follow the explicit source, ownership, dependency, composition and projection declarations from the affected targets and effects; identify each reached layer and owner, its exact basis and its changed, unchanged or unknown relation, the traversed edges and the unresolved frontier; an absent edge does not prove irrelevance. (2) Public delta: the complete relevant serialised member universe, added and removed identities and every retained member with changed value or bytes; a rename is removal plus addition unless its owner supplies an identity-preserving relation; incomplete enumeration leaves the delta unknown. (3) Accepted-design coverage: join changed bytes and relations to explicit accepted scope, traces and acceptance evidence, distinguishing covered, missing, stale, ambiguous and outside-scope; a filename, listed artifact or digest alone establishes no coverage. (4) Rule-determined treatment: apply only declared rules with sufficient input facts, exposing the smallest lawful re-entry, the next action, the applicable evidence or assessment, the reserved ruling and the carrier lifetime; a label or filename cannot select the route; when rules settle the question no residual judgment is invented.
P4b, P3, P6
Later counterevidence arrives.
Every dependent verdict is invalidated until the claim-evidence relation is requalified.

Intake triage determines six things: (1) whether the report represents a substantive change at all; (2) the affected product boundary and intended scope; (3) the lawful change class; (4) the lawful re-entry point into the constitutional chain; (5) the downstream surfaces and evidence that must be repriced, re-derived or re-proved; (6) whether the work remains within the currently declared release scope or requires repricing of that release plan.
P2, P6, P4b

A public delta or other nonconformance does not itself require changing the governing contract. If that contract remains sufficient for the authorised outcome, the candidate is rejected or locally repaired within its grant. The actual governing owner is re-entered when the explicitly selected desired outcome requires changed meaning or an applicable assessment establishes governing insufficiency. C determines that consequence only from sufficient declared premises; unresolved intended meaning or necessity is J, and any reserved decision remains O. Candidate behaviour cannot author its own target law.
P6

Before declaring realization_refactor for a bug, establish that the current requirement and the accepted realising design govern the affected behaviour and remain sufficient for the authorised outcome. Their presence proves no coverage. Missing or ambiguous evidence leaves the affected treatment unknown; it is not proof that the governing layer itself is absent.
P6

Every substantive change, whatever its intake label, enters through one intake triage that names the smallest lawful re-entry point; triage records the change intent, the class, the re-entry point and when triage occurred, wherever substantive work begins.

Ticket type answers what kind of work record this is; change class answers where the change lawfully re-enters the constitutional chain; ticket_category governs execution and closure discipline. A ticket records the change_class declared by intake triage. Common pairings: feature with goal_reprice, intent_reprice, product_reprice, requirement_reprice or design_reframe; bug with requirement_reprice, design_reframe or realization_refactor; chore with design_reframe or realization_refactor; spike carries the current triage class.
P4b, P2, P3

A ticket for substantive work carries the minimum metadata required by intake triage: the declared change_intent, the lawful change_class, the lawful re_entry_point, and when triage occurred in triaged_at. The recorded values are those intake triage declared.
P4b, P2

Triage triangulates a failure across the applicable reference frames over the same subject and basis; their combined results constrain the supported cause, preserve unresolved alternatives and uncertainty, and identify the smallest sufficient lawful scope of repair. The frame that exposes a failure need not contain its cause. Repeating the same analysis under different frame names supplies no additional causal evidence. A diagnosis grants no repair effects and does not establish that governing meaning must change: a candidate may instead need correction under sufficient existing law.
P6

There is one front door for substantive change. The intake label does not determine the process class: a reported bug, feature request, issue, regression, operator finding, release blocker or scenario failure all enter through the same intake triage. No bug, feature, issue or other intake bypasses this triage by going straight to code, tests or release handling.
P2, P6

Unknown treatment withholds dependent reliance or promotion, not unrelated authorised work. An existing bounded construction or evidence grant may permit the cheapest useful discriminator without asserting that the candidate is conformant. A mistaken route is corrected at its smallest affected owner, preserving the original cause, the attempted subject, the observed effect state and valid progress; an unknown effect state cannot be silently treated as no effect.
P5

Triage consumes the computed classification for the declared owner and layer traversal, the complete relevant public membership and value delta, the accepted-design scope and trace coverage, and the rule-determined treatment. The owning work carrier references that exact result and its residuals; a new role does not repeat an unchanged walk.
P4b, P2

The walk goes upward to the first missing layer. If the governing requirement is missing or insufficient, re-enter its owner. If that requirement is sufficient but the realising design is missing or insufficient, re-enter Design. Follow an actual upstream Goal, Intent or Product change to its owner rather than stopping at a familiar file. When the current requirement and accepted design suffice and the implementation deviates, repair or reject the candidate under realization_refactor. A candidate's public violation does not select a new contract. An explicitly changed desired outcome or an established governing insufficiency follows the owning re-entry; unresolved meaning remains J and a reserved choice remains O.
P2, P6
Authority is never minted from capability, a label or reachability.

symbols.label: Authority: an identity-bearing permission to operate or to dispose acceptance within a scope; never minted from capability, label or reachability; its kinds are frame-set, semantic, evaluation, operation and decision authority
Candidate: a step's output before evaluation
Carrier of a work item: durable ticket, sprint-local entry, or run or return record
Change class: goal_reprice, intent_reprice, product_reprice, requirement_reprice, design_reframe or realization_refactor, each with its re-entry point
Claim: an assertion with subject, property, basis, witness relation and falsifier

Closed result: identifies the frame and its activation, the subject, the basis, the evaluation, the actor, the evidence, the verdict, the residual uncertainty and the invalidation conditions; minimal shape REFERENCE_FRAME section 13; available for reuse under an applicability check

Computed classification: the one reusable classification result intake supplies (C), produced over the exact request and inputs by an explicitly selected capability and exposing authority traversal, public delta, accepted-design coverage and rule-determined treatment
The chain Goals, Intent, Product Definition, Requirements, Design and realisation, Code or documents, Events, Projection, Delta, Scenarios, Gap analysis, Repricing
Determination annotations: C reproducible facts and declared rule application; J residual semantic or materiality judgment; O a ruling reserved to its actual owner

Evidence: the exact observations or artifacts admitted to evaluate a claim on a basis, each with provenance, subject identity, basis and scope; availability inside a frame makes it neither semantic truth nor decision authority
Invalidator: a changed material input, basis or declared revising observation that invalidates a result before reliance
A layer of the chain; sufficient when a competent actor can derive a conformant next layer

Reference frame: a finite specification of the attention, coordinates, authority, evidence and result relations required to perform one declared evaluation family over a stated basis; its components are the frame tuple
Intake triage: change intent, class, re-entry point and when triage occurred
Triage metadata: change_intent, change_class, re_entry_point and triaged_at, as intake triage declared them
Upward propagation walk: from the affected behaviour upward through the governing layers to the first missing or insufficient layer, whose owner is re-entered
